articles.summary: Supports serial testing in the surveillance setting for patients with early-stage HCC Natera, Inc. (NASDAQ: NTRA), a global leader in cell-free DNA and precision medicine, today announced that its Signatera molecular residual disease (MRD) test has received Medicare coverage through the Centers for Medicare Medicaid Services’ (CMS) Molecular Diagnostics Services Program (MolDX) in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). The coverage includes serial Signatera testing in the surveillance setting for patients with early-stage HCC who have no post-surgical evidence of disease. More than 42,000 new cases of liver cancer are expected in the U.S. in 2026 1 and HCC accounts for approximately 90% of primary liver cancers. 2 Even after curative-intent treatment (e.g., surgery), patients face a high risk of recurrence that makes post-treatment monitoring critical. 2 This Medicare coverage decision was supported by a real-world study of 125 patients with HCC published in JCO Precision Oncology .
